The residue of $64$ modulo $5$ is the integer $0\le r<5$ such that

$$
64≡r\,(\text{mod}\,5).
$$

**Method 1**

To find the residue $r,$ we need to write $64$ as an integer multiple of $5,$ plus the residue $r.$

We note that $64≡4\,(\text{mod}\,5)$ because

$$
64=12\cdot 5+4.
$$

Therefore, the residue of $64$ modulo $5$ is $4.$

**Method 2**

We can use the subtraction property:

$$
\begin{aligned}64 & ≡64-0 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡64-12\cdot 5 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡64-60 &  & (\text{mod}\,5) \\  & ≡4 &  & (\text{mod}\,5)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the residue of $64$ modulo $5$ is $4.$
